Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Boys! Boys! Come quick!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What is it, Dad?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: It's the new, digitally remastered third series of Pinhead Pierre! Only the best series ever of my favorite show ever! That's all.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You had us at come quick.

Name: Pinhead Pierre
Dialog: Hi kids! (kids applaud and cheer) Kids, sometimes when your head is this small, you just want to get away for a bit. You know, escape from all the laughing and pointing. Whenever I feel like that, you know what I do? Magic carpet ride! Roll out your official Pinhead Pierre rugs, kids!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Right-o! (runs to get it) It's been at my bedside all these years! (pushes coffee table over) Hop on, boys! (all sit on rug) We're about to take off on the ride of a lifetime!

Name: Pinhead Pierre
Dialog: What's the magic word?

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Streptococcus!

Name: Pinhead Pierre
Dialog: Whoa! Whoa! We're flying!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Here we go, boys!

Name: Pinhead Pierre
Dialog: (showing obviously fake birds and clouds) And look out below! It's Paris. There's the Arc de Triomphe and there's the Eiffel Tower! And there's the Colosseum?! What's that doing here?!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Lawrence, can you look at these tile samples with me? I want to re-do the living room.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (sadly) Oh well, I suppose it wasn't quite as thrilling as I remember. Carry on, boys.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ferb, I know what we're gonna do today! Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (snores, then wakes up) WRONG PANTS! Huh? *Ahem* Oh, sorry, Agent P eh. Guess I was, uh, dozing there uh... Anyway, it appears Dr. Doofenshmirtz has completely cleared the Tri-State Area out of all grape juice, red wine, chocolate, marinara sauce, India ink, and, worst of all, (holds up mug) coffee! So, uh, go and, uh, you know, do the thing, that thing... Sorry. I'm just no good until I have that first mug o' Joe.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I try and I try and I try and I try, but no matter what I do, things never work out like I planned! (Stacy is starting to fall asleep listening to her. Candace gasps) Maybe if I knew how things were gonna turn out, I could plan for that and then do the right stuff! I know. I know. That doesn't make any sense, does it?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: You said it, sister. Have a cookie. (throws fortune cookie at her)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (sighs) I guess it's too much to expect some magic answer to all my problems. (breaks cookie) Let's see. "Somebody close to you will take a trip." Boy, I hope they take me with them.

Name: Waiter
Dialog: (trips on cookie on the ground, which is what Candace's fortune said) I'm okay!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ha ha! That was great. What a dumb coincidence. (breaks another cookie) Let's try another. "You'll know the truth when it hits you." OK, boring.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Oh, no, girl. You are not--

Name: Candace
Dialog: (breaks another cookie) "Let the wisest among you light the way." There! A light bulb! And an old guy!

Name: Old Guy
Dialog: Does anybody know where I live?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: But Candace, you jus--

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, Stacy. It's real. These cookies know what's going to happen next! I can use them to bust my brothers!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Thanks for the cookies!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Candace!

Name: Worker
Dialog: HEY! THOSE COST A TENTH OF A CENT A PIECE! (puts out another bowl) So, enjoy them in good health, I guess.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: (walks in, boys are sitting on rug looking at TV with controllers) Well, another interior design crisis averted.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Have a seat, Dad.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: What, some new video game then?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You'll see. Voice ignition system: active. Micro-filament omnidirectional jet grid: active. Anti-gravity quantum-state lift discs: active. We have lift-off in 4, 3, 2, 1. (entire second floor of the house opens up, carpet lifts off)

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Has the entire second floor always opened up like this?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We don't use it very often, but yeah.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Well, nostalgia's got nothing on this!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah, Perry the Platypus. Just in time. (pulls cart) Our flight is about to leave. Behold, the Stain-inator! What's it for, you ask? I'll tell you on the way.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It began in Gimmelshtump when I was a callow youth yearning for a career in fine art.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (Narrating) I quickly discovered that although I loved painting, (Shows young Doof ripping his painting in half) my muse was sometimes... inaccessible. (shows him lying on bed, depressed) Then one day, just as I was about to give up in frustration, inspiration struck.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I was up for three days straight gripped in glorious, artistic fever. Then finally, my masterpiece!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I rushed across the street to get my brother, Roger. He was in the middle of his favorite meal. A sloppy joe, greasy french fries with ketchup, grape juice, coffee, and chocolate pudding. And I insisted he come at once.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: That day I made a solemn vow that Roger would pay for what he'd done. (cuts to them in an office) The next morning I had the solemn vow notarized.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: But today, I will finally get my revenge! You see, my brother, the honorable mayor Roger Doofenshmirtz, will be unveiling a new piece of art for the lobby of City Hall. Hence the Stain-inator, hence revenge, hence, uh... (Perry slowly wheels himself and his trap to the edge of the jet) no more hencing. That's about it.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: I say, boys, you can barely feel the road! It corners like a dream! Pinhead Pierre, eat your heart out!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: What do you say we take the gang for a spin?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (gasps) Wow! (takes his hand)

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: Ah, thank you, boys, this was lovely.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Does anyone else want to be "king of the world"?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Ah, keep it, bro. It suits you.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay. Here we go. "You choose the path that few others dare travel." Done and done. Come on, Stace! Follow me! (runs ahead)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Really, Candace? What to you hope to accomplish by this?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Everything! Don't you see? All the problems in my life can be solved through concrete knowledge of the future!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Right; as you create a whole new set of problems.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ohhh, stop being so close-minded. (girls walking through house/apartment) For instance, what's my biggest problem?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: You believe fortune cookies are real?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I mean, besides that.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: You're totally obsessed with busting your brothers!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Exactly! And with infallible fortune cookie guidance, I can accomplish that easily. (breaks cookie) Watch. "If something seems fishy, maybe it's a fish!"

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (sarcastically) Genius.

Name: Fish seller
Dialog: Heya! Catch it now! Fresh fish! Fresh fish!

Name: Candace
Dialog: What do you have to say now, Doubty McNonbelief?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Why am I suddenly Irish?

Name: Candace
Dialog: To the fish market!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Excuse me, have you guys seen two little... (fish seller throws a fish to Candace) Oof! (Candace throws the fish to Stacy)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Ew! Gross!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Gross... but foretold, Stacy. Preordained! What's next? What's next?!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: Better be something about soap.

Name: Candace
Dialog: "One man's trash is another man's treasure." To the Dumpster!

Name: Candace
Dialog: "Success starts at home." Finally! It's go time! To the backyard!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: It gets hard to watch.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Boy, it's just gorgeous out, huh? A perfect day for ruining a City Hall lobby art dedication. You know, if-if you're into that kind of thing. Which I am!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Heh-heh. Either way, it's nice to get out of the lab for a change and, you know, try to destroy each other out in the fresh air.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Like a field trip! TO THE DEATH!

Name: Woman
Dialog: Thank you!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'm sure if I thought about it, I could come up with some emotionally-scarring back-stories that are more outdoors-y... (Perry kicks Doofenshmirtz) Aouagh!

Name: Psychiatrist
Dialog: (holding up a Rorschach blot) What does this look like to you?

Name: Patient
Dialog: (pointing at the stained window) That.

Name: Man
Dialog: Well, it's great to finally meet you in... ah... chPERSON! (he sneezes on the last word; as he does so, a mucus-colored stain ball hits the woman in the face. The man coughs.) So, when can I see you again?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wow, not only does this thing work, it has a sense of irony! (Perry punches Doofenshmirtz) Ow!... AAAAAHHHHHH!

Name: Roger
Dialog: (addressing a crowd on the front steps of City Hall) Thank you, friends, and welcome.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (climbing back onto the Stain-inator) Right on time.

Name: Roger
Dialog: It fills me with great pride to contribute today to the cultural enrichment of the Tri-State Area. I've always been a great lover of the arts.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Liar, liar, pantalones del fuego. (Perry starts attacking Doofenshmirtz from behind) Yah! You again? (Doofenshmirtz presses a button on the remote) There. Auto-fire in 30 seconds. Nothing can stop it now.

Name: Roger
Dialog: You see, the greatest painting I ever saw was made by my brother Heinz.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You'd better believe it! Art killer.

Name: Roger
Dialog: And I, in an extraordinary act of clumsiness, destroyed it, denying him the accolades he so craved and deserved.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And here comes the payback...!

Name: Roger
Dialog: And that's why I've spent the last two decades restoring it to its former glory.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: What? Huh, what? (rapidly pressing the remote) No no! No no! No no no no... OH NOOOOOO!!!!

Name: Roger
Dialog: Ladies and gentlemen, (removes the cover from the painting) my brother's painting! (a purple stain ball immediately hits the painting)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: NOOOOOOoooohoohoohooooo...

Name: Roger
Dialog: Well, that was 20 years well-spent. (at his secretary) Melanie, what's my next appointment?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Go ahead, Perry the Platypus. I don't care anymore.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Gotta get home, gotta get home... (gasps) There they are!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Fate is kind.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Behold this, you stupid... (kicks Stain-inator, causing one stain ball to fly out)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (running inside) Hee, hee, hee, hee, hee, hee...

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Did anyone else feel a drop?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (in the kitchen) Mom! Mom! Mom!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hi Candace. That's a nice look for you.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You gotta see. Carpet! Living room. (pulls Linda away from the counter; the knife she was holding spins a few times and sticks in the counter) Now! Look.(drags Linda into the living room, where Lawrence and the kids have safely landed. The carpet has been dyed purple from the stain ball)

Name: Linda
Dialog: A new living room carpet! Oh, that's much better than tile. How lovely!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Bubububububu...

Name: Linda
Dialog: You surprised me, Lawrence. I thought you were gonna sit in front of this TV all day.

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: I... did!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, you. (to the kids) I think this calls for a celebration. Who wants Chinese?

Name: Phineas, Ferb, Buford, Baljeet, Isabella
Dialog: Me!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Me!

Name: Lawrence
Dialog: I do!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: You okay, kiddo?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I don't get it! These things have been right about everything. I mean, look!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: "Don't believe everything you read." Words to live by.
